name: Manali
description: Snow-capped peaks, adventure sports, and cozy cafes nestled in the Beas river valley.
food_tip: Try sidu (local bread) and siddu at Old Manali cafes
dinner_tip: Johnson's Cafe for trout and wood-fired pizza
local_tips: Carry warm layers even in summer – nights drop below 10°C
Book Rohtang Pass permit online 2 days in advance
Old Manali is far more charming than the mall road area

activities.name: Solang Valley Snow Point
activities.tip: Go early to avoid crowds and slush

activities.name: Rohtang Pass visit
activities.tip: Permits required; book at least 2 days prior

activities.name: Beas River rafting
activities.tip: Grade II-III rapids, safe for beginners

activities.name: Hadimba Devi Temple
activities.tip: Peaceful before 9 AM

activities.name: Old Manali cafe hopping
activities.tip: Dylan's Toasted & Roasted is a must

activities.name: Jogini Waterfall trek
activities.tip: Easy 2-hour return trek, carry water

activities.name: Vashisht hot springs
activities.tip: Soothing after a day of activities

activities.name: Naggar Castle visit
activities.tip: Stunning Himalayan views from the top

name: Goa
description: Sun, sand, seafood, and the timeless Portuguese charm of India's favourite beach destination.
food_tip: Eat at beach shacks for fresh catch – avoid restaurant menus
dinner_tip: Fisherman's Wharf or Gunpowder for authentic Goan cuisine
local_tips: Renting a scooter (₹300/day) is the best way to get around
North Goa for nightlife; South Goa for peace and cleaner beaches
Avoid weekends if visiting water sports zones – massively crowded

activities.name: Baga Beach water sports
activities.tip: Parasailing + jet ski combo is worth it

activities.name: Dudhsagar Waterfall day trip
activities.tip: Book jeep safari from Collem village

activities.name: Fort Aguada sunset
activities.tip: Arrive 30 mins before sunset for the golden light

activities.name: Anjuna Flea Market
activities.tip: Every Wednesday; bargain hard

activities.name: Cruise on Mandovi River
activities.tip: Sunset cruise has live Goan folk music

activities.name: Old Goa churches walk
activities.tip: Basilica of Bom Jesus is a UNESCO site

activities.name: Spice plantation tour
activities.tip: Includes lunch and elephant interaction

activities.name: Nightlife at Tito's Lane
activities.tip: LPK Waterfront is more scenic for couples

name: Coorg (Kodagu)
description: The Scotland of India – misty coffee estates, waterfalls, and the warmth of Kodava hospitality.
food_tip: Try Pandi Curry (pork) and Akki Roti – Coorg's iconic dishes
dinner_tip: Raintree restaurant for authentic Kodava meals
local_tips: Roads are narrow and winding – avoid driving at night
Best season: October to March; monsoon is beautiful but roads get slippery
Buy fresh coffee powder directly from estates – much cheaper

activities.name: Abbey Falls
activities.tip: Best during post-monsoon for full flow

activities.name: Dubare Elephant Camp
activities.tip: Book elephant bathing experience at 7 AM

activities.name: Nagarhole National Park safari
activities.tip: Elephant and tiger sightings are common

activities.name: Talakaveri – Kaveri origin trek
activities.tip: Sacred site; short but steep climb

activities.name: Raja's Seat sunset
activities.tip: Views over misty valleys – magical at golden hour

activities.name: Coffee estate walk
activities.tip: Most homestays include a guided estate tour

activities.name: Iruppu Waterfalls
activities.tip: Combine with Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary walk

activities.name: Madikeri Fort
activities.tip: Fort museum tells the Kodagu royal history

name: Jaisalmer
description: The Golden City rises from the Thar Desert like a mirage – an ancient fort city, camel dunes, and desert camps.
food_tip: Dal baati churma at any rooftop restaurant in the Fort area
dinner_tip: Rooftop cafes inside Jaisalmer Fort have the best ambiance
local_tips: Stay inside the living Fort for an authentic experience
Negotiate camel safari prices – ₹400-600 per hour is fair
Desert camp overnight is worth every rupee

activities.name: Sam Sand Dunes camel safari
activities.tip: Sunset on the dunes is unmissable – arrive by 5:30 PM

activities.name: Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Qila) walk
activities.tip: Living fort with 4,000 residents – get lost in the lanes

activities.name: Patwon Ki Haveli
activities.tip: 5 interconnected havelis with intricate carvings

activities.name: Desert camp with cultural night
activities.tip: Includes dinner, folk music, and stargazing

activities.name: Gadsisar Lake sunrise
activities.tip: Migratory birds in winter; boat ride available

activities.name: Kuldhara ghost village
activities.tip: Abandoned in 1825; eerie and fascinating

activities.name: Desert National Park jeep safari
activities.tip: Great Indian Bustard sightings; book in advance

name: Rishikesh
description: The adventure capital of India meets the yoga capital of the world, where the Ganga roars through the Himalayan foothills.
food_tip: Chotiwala restaurant – try the thali near Laxman Jhula
dinner_tip: Little Buddha Cafe has great Ganga views and Mediterranean food
local_tips: No meat or alcohol sold in Rishikesh – stock up in Haridwar if needed
Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat at 6 PM is a must-attend
Book rafting directly with Shivpuri operators to avoid middlemen

activities.name: White water rafting Shivpuri to Rishikesh
activities.tip: 16 km stretch with grade 3-4 rapids; best Sep-Nov and Mar-May

activities.name: Bungee jumping at Jumpin Heights
activities.tip: India's highest fixed platform bungee; book online 2 days prior

activities.name: Laxman Jhula & Ram Jhula walk
activities.tip: Cross both suspension bridges; great views at sunrise

activities.name: Yoga & meditation class
activities.tip: Parmarth Niketan offers free evening yoga

activities.name: Neer Garh Waterfall trek
activities.tip: 45-min easy trek; great for a swim

activities.name: Camping at Shivpuri
activities.tip: Bonfire + Ganga side camp is worth the cost

activities.name: Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat
activities.tip: Arrive by 5:30 PM for a front row spot

name: Ooty (Udhagamandalam)
description: The Queen of Hill Stations – British-era charm, tea gardens, and toy train rides through misty Nilgiri forests.
food_tip: Ooty homemade chocolates and varkey biscuits are famous – buy at Charing Cross
dinner_tip: Willy's Coffee Pub has good South Indian + Continental fusion
local_tips: Nilgiri Mountain Railway toy train from Mettupalayam is a UNESCO experience
Botanical Gardens are best in May during annual flower show
Doddabetta Peak can be foggy – go in the morning for clear views

activities.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway toy train ride
activities.tip: Book tickets at least a week ahead; window seats on the right side

activities.name: Botanical Gardens
activities.tip: 55-acre garden with a 20-million-year-old fossil tree

activities.name: Doddabetta Peak
activities.tip: Highest point in Nilgiris at 2637m; clear views before 10 AM

activities.name: Tea factory tour – Nilgiri tea
activities.tip: Folkington's or Korakundah estates offer guided tours

activities.name: Pykara Lake & Falls
activities.tip: Boat ride on Pykara Lake with pine forest backdrop

activities.name: Ooty Lake boating
activities.tip: Paddle boats and motor boats available; lovely in the mist

activities.name: Mukurthi National Park trek
activities.tip: Nilgiri Tahr and deer sightings common; permit needed
